note: Family-owned campground near Alger with a clubhouse and game room. Near Greenwood Lake (no-wake, sandy beach just west of camp) and the Rifle River Rec Area. No working website of its own (2026-10). --Claude
summary: No operator page: the Google listing's site (greenwoodcanpground.com, sic) redirects to booking.com search results, greenwoodcampground.com redirects to an unavailable Facebook page, and the only description is the Pure Michigan listing (50 sites, clubhouse, showers, weekend store; phone (989) 345-2778, matching the entry). Google Maps: 'Greenwood Campground', 636 Greenwood Rd, Alger, 4.6 stars from 102 reviews, (989) 345-2778, not marked closed. RV Life: $$ tier (avg $28, only 2 ratings). Cleared the directory-only 30-amp/water; count 50 and showers/store now reported from the tourism listing. No rate, season or booking method published anywhere. Note cleaned of hookup/transient text.
flags: Website is the michigan.org tourism listing, and no operator site or Facebook page could be found to replace it: the website on the Google listing, http://greenwoodcanpground.com/ (sic), redirects to booking.com search results (dead or hijacked domain), and http://greenwoodcampground.com/ redirects to a Facebook page 'Greenwood Family Campground' that reports 'This content isn't available right now'.

Presence passes only on Google Maps (open listing, 4.6 stars / 102 reviews, phone (989) 345-2778). Price: no posted rate and no booking engine; the only indicator is RV Life's $$ tier (avg_rate $28, 2 ratings). Season, rates and booking method are unpublished; a phone call would confirm it still operates. No gateway within 40 km (Sleeping Bear Dunes 167 km); the family has not stayed here.
